name: Motors & Motion
artwork: Original editable TinyCAD vector motors, shafts, housings, boards, connectors, sensors and mechanical parts; no product photos, logos, traces or imported icon sets.
scope: Compact wiring/layout resources for robotics and automation. Generic devices expose functional conductor terminals rather than commercial package/cable pinouts; the three named Pololu carriers retain source-checked component-side header order. Hose ports represent complete pneumatic connections; cable ports represent complete interfaces. Mechanical shafts/mounts are artwork, not electrical points. No SPICE, firmware, motion simulation, internal netlist connections or implied ratings.

references.title: Pololu metal gearmotors with encoder
references.facts: Brushed DC geared motors can provide motor terminals plus separately powered quadrature feedback.

references.title: NI four-, six- and eight-wire steppers
references.facts: Four leads expose two complete windings; six leads add centre taps; eight leads expose individual half-windings.

references.title: Oriental Motor brushless motor overview
references.facts: Brushless motors require a matching driver/commutation system; optional Hall feedback is distinct from phase power.

references.title: Adafruit servo connections and modes
references.facts: RC servos use supply, ground and pulse-control conductors. Positional and continuous-rotation modes differ.

references.title: ROBOTIS smart actuator communication
references.facts: Half-duplex TTL and RS-485 smart-servo buses are different interfaces.

references.title: Pololu A4988 carrier #1182
references.facts: Verified component-side header order, separate VDD and VMOT inputs and active-low enable/reset/sleep.

references.title: Pololu DRV8825 carrier #2133
references.facts: Verified header order; FAULT replaces A4988 VDD; no separate logic supply; bottom solderable ground pad.

references.title: Pololu TB6612FNG carrier #713
references.facts: Verified labelled top view: left power/motor bank and right PWM/direction/standby bank. STBY must be high to run.

references.title: Adafruit PCA9685 servo distribution guide
references.facts: Sixteen PWM outputs share a frequency; logic VCC and distributed servo V+ are separate. Generic board artwork is not a specific Adafruit revision.

references.title: Broadcom encoder questions and answers
references.facts: Quadrature A/B outputs encode relative movement; an optional index gives a reference pulse.

references.title: ams OSRAM AS5600 magnetic angle evaluation guide
references.facts: Contactless magnetic angle measurement and I2C control; the generic breakout is not a package pinout.

references.title: Omron NPN and PNP proximity output guide
references.facts: NPN sensors sink output current; PNP sensors source output current. These are separate resources.

references.title: Firgelli potentiometer feedback actuators
references.facts: A feedback rod actuator combines two motor leads and three potentiometer feedback leads.

references.title: SMC five-port solenoid valve guide
references.facts: Pneumatic valve ports and coil terminals serve different roles; working ports feed a double-acting cylinder.

references.title: Pololu mechanical components
references.facts: Wheels, casters, mounting parts and shaft couplings support robot motion assemblies.

references.title: ams AS5048A/AS5048B angle-sensor data sheet
references.facts: AS5048A provides SPI absolute-angle readout; SPI and I2C angle-sensor breakouts are distinct interfaces.

references.title: Omron D2F switch contact forms
references.facts: A basic SPDT limit switch exposes common, normally-open and normally-closed contacts; actuator shapes vary.

references.title: Johnson Electric Ledex solenoid families
references.facts: Linear/open-frame solenoids and latching variants are available; coil and latch configurations depend on the selected assembly.

references.title: Johnson Electric rotary solenoids
references.facts: Rotary solenoids move a shaft through a limited angular stroke and differ from continuously rotating motors.

sourceReview.decision: Fetched motor and limit-switch candidates are conventional circuit glyphs with incompatible physical artwork/endpoints. This bundle extends the original physical layout library style.
